event_chain.summary: Privilege abuse - LPR lookups shared with cousin

summary: A San Jose Police Department officer used the department's Flock license-plate reader database from his personal phone, without a law-enforcement purpose, to find vehicle location information on a woman who had accused his cousin of domestic violence, and shared the results with the cousin. The misuse came to light in February 2026 when the woman told police the accused knew her whereabouts; an audit trail confirmed the improper searches. The officer was fired in April 2026 and the chief barred database access from personal devices.
